en.i1t: Five sessions, four active days — two full rest days in seven
en.i1: 5 sessions across 4 active days, 5h21 and ~2,740 active kcal. Two strength days (Saturday's trap-bar deadlift, Tuesday's hack squat), two Zagreb hikes totalling 11.9 km, and one 2.2 km pool set. Friday and Wednesday were both complete rest days; today is just starting. Saturday was the biggest single day at 817 active kcal — a 57-minute lift followed straight by a 52-minute hike. Tuesday's hack squat carries the only logged tonnage: 12,506 kg over 21 sets and 168 reps.
en.i2t: Hack squat's 185 kg is still the week's headline
en.i2: Tuesday's top set was 185 kg × 6, held for three working sets, against 160 kg × 10 × 3 on Jul 21. Top-end load is up 25 kg (+16%) while the lift's own tonnage fell from 6,040 to 4,890 kg and total session volume from 13,480 to 12,506 kg. Per-set HR peaks ran 108 → 129 → 115 → 120 → 131 → 134 → 138 across the seven sets. The heavier session was the cheaper one cardiovascularly: the 185 kg sixes peaked at 131/134/138 where the 160 kg tens peaked at 137/145/147 — shorter sets, lower demand, more load on the machine. Two days on it has not been followed up: Wednesday was a rest day.
en.i3t: Swim intervals skipped for the third week running
en.i3: Wednesday's pool session is in the plan and has now gone untaken three weeks in a row — 68 active kcal on the day and no activity recorded. Monday's 2,225 m (10×100 / 10×50, avg HR 129, max 155, 759 kcal) is the window's only swim, which leaves pool volume at half the plan. Saturday's trap-bar deadlift (57 min, avg HR 105, max 136, 411 kcal) also never reached Hevy, so it carries no tonnage or per-set peaks and its name comes from the weekly plan rather than the log.
en.i4t: Recovery: sleep rebounded hard, HRV did not
en.i4: Last night ran 7h 34m at score 84 — the window's longest and best night, 1h 12m over the 6h 22m average, with deep sleep at 107 minutes and REM at 141, both up sharply. But HRV fell to 34, the seven-night low and 9 under the 43 average, and RHR held at 55 for a fourth straight morning. Average stress was 23. Two rest days plus the longest night of the week is a sound base for today's squat; the low HRV is the argument for holding load rather than adding it.
en.rec: Today's squat can go ahead. Wednesday was an unplanned rest day, legs have had two clear days since the 185 kg hack squat, and last night delivered 7h 34m at score 84. Hold the load at last Thursday's numbers rather than chasing the hack squat's jump — HRV at 34 is the seven-night low, and stacking a second new stimulus onto a suppressed reading is how a good week turns into a stalled one. The real gap is the pool: Wednesday's swim has now been skipped three weeks running, so pool volume sits at 2.2 km against a 4.4 km plan. Move it into Friday's rest slot this week rather than writing it off again — it is aerobic, costs the legs nothing, and Friday is otherwise empty. Next: squat today, swim Friday in place of rest, trap-bar deadlift Saturday, rest or hike Sunday.

Garmin aktivna potrošnja prosj. ~391 kcal/dan, vrhunac 817 na subotnjem dvostrukom danu (trap-bar mrtvo dizanje + 4,9 km planinarenja) i 653 na nedjeljnom usponu od 7,0 km. Petak (70 kcal) i srijeda (68 kcal) bili su potpuni dani odmora; četvrtak (30.7.) tek počinje, s planiranim čučnjem.

hr.i1t: Pet treninga, četiri aktivna dana — dva potpuna odmora u sedam
hr.i1: 5 treninga kroz 4 aktivna dana, 5h21 i ~2.740 aktivnih kcal. Dva dana snage (subotnje trap-bar mrtvo dizanje, utorkov hack squat), dva zagrebačka uspona ukupno 11,9 km i jedan bazenski set od 2,2 km. Petak i srijeda bili su potpuni dani odmora; danas tek počinje. Subota je bila najveći pojedinačni dan s 817 aktivnih kcal — trening snage od 57 minuta pa odmah uspon od 52 minute. Utorkov hack squat jedini nosi zabilježenu tonažu: 12.506 kg kroz 21 seriju i 168 ponavljanja.
hr.i2t: Hack squat sa 185 kg i dalje je glavna vijest tjedna
hr.i2: Utorkova najteža serija bila je 185 kg × 6, zadržana kroz tri radne serije, naspram 160 kg × 10 × 3 od 21.7. Vršni teret veći je za 25 kg (+16%), dok je tonaža same vježbe pala sa 6.040 na 4.890 kg, a ukupni volumen treninga sa 13.480 na 12.506 kg. Vrhovi pulsa po seriji išli su 108 → 129 → 115 → 120 → 131 → 134 → 138 kroz sedam serija. Teži je trening bio jeftiniji za srce: šestice sa 185 kg vrhovile su na 131/134/138, dok su desetke sa 160 kg išle na 137/145/147 — kraće serije, manji zahtjev, više tereta na spravi. Dva dana kasnije nije bilo nastavka: srijeda je bila dan odmora.
hr.i3t: Bazenski intervali preskočeni treći tjedan zaredom
hr.i3: Srijedin bazenski trening je u planu, a sada je treći tjedan zaredom neodrađen — 68 aktivnih kcal na dan i nijedna zabilježena aktivnost. Ponedjeljkovih 2.225 m (10×100 / 10×50, prosj. puls 129, maks 155, 759 kcal) jedino je plivanje u prozoru, što ostavlja bazenski volumen na pola plana. Subotnje trap-bar mrtvo dizanje (57 min, prosj. puls 105, maks 136, 411 kcal) također nikad nije stiglo u Hevy, pa nema tonažu ni vrhove pulsa po seriji, a naziv mu dolazi iz tjednog plana, ne iz zapisa.
hr.i4t: Oporavak: san se snažno vratio, HRV nije
hr.i4: Sinoć je noć trajala 7h 34m uz ocjenu 84 — najdulja i najbolja u prozoru, 1h 12m iznad prosjeka od 6h 22m, uz duboki san na 107 minuta i REM na 141, oboje znatno više. No HRV je pao na 34, minimum sedam noći i 9 ispod prosjeka od 43, a RHR se četvrto jutro zaredom drži na 55. Prosječni stres bio je 23. Dva dana odmora plus najdulja noć u tjednu solidna su baza za današnji čučanj; nizak HRV je argument da se teret zadrži, a ne poveća.
hr.rec: Današnji čučanj može se odraditi. Srijeda je bila neplanirani dan odmora, noge su imale dva čista dana nakon hack squata sa 185 kg, a sinoć je donijela 7h 34m uz ocjenu 84. Zadrži teret na prošločetvrtkovim brojkama, bez trčanja za skokom s hack squata — HRV od 34 minimum je sedam noći, a slaganje drugog novog podražaja na potisnuto očitanje način je da dobar tjedan zastane. Prava rupa je bazen: srijedino plivanje preskočeno je treći tjedan zaredom, pa je bazenski volumen na 2,2 km naspram plana od 4,4 km. Prebaci ga ovaj tjedan u petkov slot odmora umjesto da ga opet otpišeš — aerobno je, ne košta noge ništa, a petak je inače prazan. Sljedeće: čučanj danas, plivanje u petak umjesto odmora, trap-bar mrtvo dizanje u subotu, odmor ili planinarenje u nedjelju.
